summary: AIOS Tech Inc., a Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer formerly Nisun International, filed a routine Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements and XBRL exhibits for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing references prior private placements of Class A shares and warrants, related-party transactions, customer concentration, and share incentive plan grants, but discloses no new special-situations event such as a merger, tender offer, strategic review, or abrupt management change. This is an ordinary periodic report under the 1934 Act. No deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are stated; no risk-arb angle applies.
